commonMeasurement.rawObservable: fixed-reference-plane complex two-port scattering matrix S_h(omega)
commonMeasurement.realCarrierCondition: reciprocity plus one common port-phase calibration makes C_h real symmetric
commonMeasurement.primaryStatistic: the preregistered A_perp first-harmonic transverse statistic from document 1222
requiredChecks: same calibration and reference planes in all sectors
same frequency grid, temperature and drive power
randomized preparation order with at least three repeats
sham operation and held-out null fixture
resolved third singular direction in at least two adjacent bins and an independent replication

nearProtocol.claimClass: continuous-U1-holonomy sampled at three preregistered phases
nearProtocol.device: two-path coherent quantum-phase-slip or fluxon interferometer enclosing a gate-controlled superconducting island, weakly coupled to the same two microwave ports
nearProtocol.auxiliaryObservable: fluxon or phase-slip interference amplitude and resonant spectrum versus n_g
nuisanceControls: dummy gate matched for electrostatic loading but not enclosed charge
disable one coherent path so Aharonov-Casher interference must vanish
measure offset-charge drift and quasiparticle-parity jumps
hold magnetic flux, temperature and microwave power fixed
repeat after redistributing local circuit parameters at fixed enclosed charge
billOfMaterials: superconducting loop or junction chain with two coherent fluxon/phase-slip paths
gate island with calibrated gate capacitance C_g and charge-stability monitor
two weak microwave coupling ports or resonators
tunable element or fabricated control device that disables one path
independent magnetic-flux bias and filtered gate-voltage lines
vector network analyser or two-channel lock-in
cryogenic attenuation, isolation, thermometry and magnetic shielding
missingQuantitativeInputs: coherent path amplitudes and their relative dynamical phase
gate capacitance and offset-charge noise spectrum
junction capacitances and Josephson or phase-slip energies
port coupling matrix and internal/external linewidths
temperature, quasiparticle-poisoning rate and coherence time

topolectricalAlternative.controlKnob: total directed link phase Phi=phi_1+phi_2+phi_3 modulo 2pi
decisiveControls: redistribute edge phases at fixed total Phi
cut one edge to destroy the loop
audit active or nonreciprocal elements so gain is not mistaken for positive passive response

protectedProtocol.device: nu=2/3 fractional quantum Hall or fractional Chern-insulator edge with alternating superconducting and charge-preserving gapped regions, producing a pair or network of Z3 parafermion domain walls
controlKnobs: gate-defined strengths and lengths of superconducting and charge-preserving gapped segments
architecture-derived quasiparticle transfer or Wilson-string operation X
threePreparations: project or initialize a reference W eigenstate |0>
apply the validated nonlocal increment operation X once to prepare |1>
verify W=1, omega, omega^2 before and after the response sweep
observables: the same positive dissipative two-port matrix C_m(omega)
sector-resolved spectral branch under phi -> phi+2pi
6pi return of a fixed sector in the minimal Z3 branch model
nuisanceControls: quasiparticle poisoning and uncontrolled sector switching
local subgap states and non-topological resonances
device with one gapped domain removed
local perturbations away from both domain walls
billOfMaterials: validated nu=2/3 fractional Hall or fractional Chern-insulator channel
superconducting contacts compatible with the fractional edge
gate-defined charge-preserving backscattering or quantum-dot-array segments
at least two separated superconducting/gapped interfaces
architecture-specific quasiparticle injection or string-control structure
two weak microwave probes with common calibration
cryogenic filtering, thermometry and poisoning monitor
missingQuantitativeInputs: microscopic edge and proximity Hamiltonian for the selected material stack
parafermion coupling E_P and ordinary Josephson coupling E_J
domain-wall localization length and finite-size splitting
port coupling operators and predicted C_m(omega)
scaling under local perturbations and domain-wall separation
admissionConditions: W^3=I on the measured low-energy space
all three W eigenvalues are prepared and verified
local observables cannot efficiently mix sectors in the protected regime
sector splitting or mixing decreases with domain-wall separation
a 2pi phase advance permutes branches and a fixed branch returns after 6pi
the same two probes and positive response estimator are used in every sector
ordinary periodicity, Landau-Zener and poisoning controls pass

digitalProtectedAlternative.status: experimentally demonstrated discrete Z3 code and parafermion-defect algebra, but not a passive material superselection sector or a native microwave admittance experiment
digitalProtectedAlternative.use: validate sector preparation, Wilson strings and local-indistinguishability analysis before material hardware exists

continuousEmulationStopLine: choosing three points on a continuous phase dial is not discrete topological order
a genuine Z3 experiment must verify W^3=I and three eigenvalues on one admitted low-energy space
sector changes must require a declared nonlocal string or quasiparticle-transfer process rather than an ordinary local knob
robustness must be shown against local perturbations and by separation or size scaling
fractional periodicity alone is insufficient because non-topological dynamics can imitate it
